Jade: Quick sync — deciding final webinar topic for Apr 28. Options: 1) 'Cost-aware LLM serving' 2) 'Scaling inference: runbook + demos' 3) 'Model-safehouse deep dive'
Marcos: Leaning to #2, hits product + demos. :thumbsup:
Alice Nguyen: Agree #2 — easier to demo routing + fallbacks.
Liz (Sales): +1 if we have clear lead capture: enterprise interest checkbox + Tier question on form.
Priya: Can speakers confirm availability? @Sam can you schedule a 30m run-through next week?
Sam (Ops): Yep, I can carve out Wed 9am PT or Thurs 2pm PT. Which works for everyone?
Marcos: Wed 9am PT works for me.
Jade: I'll lock Wed 9am PT. Agenda for rehearsal: slides + live demo dry-run + fallback test + Q&A scripts. Draft run-of-show below:
Jade: ```
00:00–00:05 Intro + housekeeping (Jade)
00:05–00:20 Core talk: Why inference matters (Marcos)
00:20–00:35 Live demo: Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private switch (Marcos + Alice)
00:35–00:45 Customer story / panel (Liz)
00:45–00:55 Q&A (all)
00:55–01:00 CTA + lead routing notes (Jade)
```
Priya: Demo fallback checklist for rehearsal: 1) network sim (lag) 2) force model variant fallback 3) replay cached responses.
Sam (Ops): I'll provision a small Dedicated pool and one Private VM for the dry run; adding scripts to repo here: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link
Marcos: For demo, we should prepare a short prompt set that highlights latency vs cost tradeoffs. I'll paste the prompts to the doc.
Jade: Marketing asks: we need 3 x tweet-length blurbs, 2 x LinkedIn posts, and a landing page hero copy. I'll draft and share by Tue EOD.
Liz (Sales): On the landing form: ensure hidden field 'demo_interest' and utm_source; also route leads with 'webinar=ai-serving' tag to HubSpot list 'WBNR-Ready'.
Sam (Ops): Routing script snippet for HubSpot tagging:
Sam (Ops): ```
curl -X POST https://api.hubspot.com/contacts/v1/contact?hapikey=$HUBSPOT_KEY \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"properties": [{"property": "email","value": "{{email}}"},{"property":"webinar","value":"ai-serving"}]}'
```
Priya: We'll rehearse the fallback path at minute 22 — plan to throttle the hosted endpoint and verify automatic routing to Dedicated, then to Private.
Alice Nguyen: Small ask for speakers: upload final slides to Drive by Mon 5pm PT and include a 1-slide backup (video-free) for failover.
Jade: Also need permission to record + email registrants recording link. @Liz can you confirm preferred gating (everyone vs registrants only)?
Liz (Sales): Registrants only. We'll send follow-up email + lead scoring rule: if watched >50% mark, mark as SQL.
Jade: Great. One more — who will monitor chat during live? @Priya can you take chat, @Alice can monitor infra questions, @Marcos takes product questions.
Priya: I'll be on chat. Will create a shared doc for curated answers.
Jade: Perfect. Any other blockers before I publish the registration page?
Marcos: None from infra. Ready.
Liz (Sales): Go ahead but add 'Request a demo' CTA linked to calendar.
Jade: Publishing now — calendar + landing link in #announcements once live. :rocket:
